name: Addlemind
body:
Source Dirty Tactics Toolbox pg. 9
Price 75 gp; Weight —
Type ingested; Save Fortitude DC 15
Onset 1 minute; Frequency 1/minute for 10 minutes
Effect 1d2 Wisdom damage. As long as any Wisdom damage from this poison remains, the victim also takes a -5 penalty on all Knowledge and Perception checks
Cure 2 saves
